mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by > 2% in a month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a sharp rise in housing starts signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by > 10% in 3 months when UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2%, a sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS drops by > 100k in a month
failure_condition: PAYEMS drops by > 100k in a month when FEDFUNDS > 2%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate loans signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS drops by > 5% in a month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.
